error.certificate_changed: Backuparr's certificate changed since you trusted it. Check it under Settings, Repairs first.

trust_certificate.title: Trust Backuparr's certificate?
trust_certificate.description:
Backuparr at {url} uses a certificate Home Assistant can't check, such as its own self-signed one. Its SHA-256 fingerprint is:

`{fingerprint}`

Compare it with the one on the Backuparr card in Backuparr (Settings, Server). Submit only if they match: Home Assistant then trusts this certificate, and the renewals Backuparr makes itself.

confirm.title: Trust Backuparr's new certificate?
confirm.description:
Backuparr ({title}) now shows a certificate with a different key, so Home Assistant stopped reading it. Its SHA-256 fingerprint is:

`{fingerprint}`

This is expected after setting Backuparr up again or changing its certificate. Compare it with the one on the Backuparr card in Backuparr (Settings, Server), and submit only if they match.
